headline: Purdue Northwest win at Northern Michigan to extend their run
dek: Purdue Northwest won at Northern Michigan, where they had lost in October, and have won every match since their defeat at Saginaw Valley State. Saginaw Valley State, beaten once all season, were held at home by Roosevelt, who host Purdue Northwest next.
displaced_by: The standing dek stopped being true. Saginaw Valley State's latest match against a member was a home draw with Roosevelt, not the win at Northern Michigan, and they have now conceded twelve, not eleven. Purdue Northwest's away win at Northern Michigan, which extends their run, is the new story.

pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Davenport and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Neither of the table's top sides won their latest match; Purdue Northwest, who beat Northern Michigan away, meet Roosevelt next.
